criteria.name: FR Coverage and MoSCoW Prioritization
criteria.description: Every F- cites FR-s; every Must-have FR- is covered by some F-. MoSCoW priority clearly marked.

scale.3: 100% of Must-have FRs covered, all F- cite valid [FR-] IDs with clear priority.
scale.2: All Must-have FRs covered, but minor citation formatting issue.
scale.1: One or more Must-have FRs missing from features.
scale.0: No FRs covered or no [FR-] citations.

criteria.name: Feature-Specific Testable Acceptance Criteria
criteria.description: Every AC- is testable by a machine or clear human check using Given/When/Then. Written specifically for that feature's action and expected result. No vague filler ('should be easy', 'seamless', 'intuitive').

scale.3: All ACs use Given/When/Then with specific actors, triggers, and concrete verifiable results. Zero boilerplate placeholders.
scale.2: Given/When/Then used throughout, but 1-2 criteria slightly generic.
scale.1: Contains vague phrases ('should be easy', 'seamless', 'intuitive') or non-testable statements.
scale.0: ACs missing Given/When/Then format or purely generic.

criteria.name: Unhappy Paths and Error Scenarios
criteria.description: Every feature has at least one explicit unhappy path acceptance criterion covering realistic failure modes, invalid inputs, timeouts, or permission denials.

scale.3: Every feature has a realistic, tailored unhappy path AC with explicit state preservation and error feedback.
scale.2: Unhappy paths present for all features, but generic failure conditions.
scale.1: Some features lack unhappy path ACs.

criteria.name: Non-Goals and Scope Boundaries
criteria.description: Non-goals table (NG-###) present with clear reasons (timeline/budget/deferred) and source citations [Q-###].

scale.3: Clear non-goals listed with explicit rationale (deferred to v2/budget) and source citations.
scale.2: Non-goals present, but reasons lack detail or citations.
scale.1: Non-goals vague or not distinguished from v1.

criteria.name: Success Metrics and Measurement Methods
criteria.description: Every metric (M-###) has a concrete target and an explicit way to measure it (telemetry, query, log). Metrics client didn't give are marked in ASM-.

scale.3: Every metric has a specific numerical target and explicit measurement method (event/query/log). Client-given numbers preserved.
scale.2: Metrics have targets and measurement, but minor ambiguity in measurement.
scale.1: Metrics lack explicit measurement methods or targets are untestable.

criteria.name: FR vs NFR Separation and NFR Table Cleanliness
criteria.description: No technical NFRs (latency, local SQLite storage, offline mode) disguised as features in Section 5. Section 6 NFR table has clean categories, numeric or yes/no targets, and [NFR-] sources without truncation.

scale.3: Clean separation: features are purely functional capabilities. Section 6 has real NFR names, numeric/boolean targets, and [NFR-] sources with zero truncation.
scale.2: Clean separation, but minor table formatting imperfection.
scale.1: 1 technical NFR misfiled as a functional feature, or NFR table has truncation.
scale.0: Severe confusion of FRs and NFRs; truncated rows or missing targets.

criteria.name: Grounding and Zero Invented Roles/Boilerplate
criteria.description: Every sentence in Sections 2, 3, and 4 traces to client discovery answers. No invented roles ('Workspace Administrator'), no generic boilerplate, correct specific Q-### citations.

scale.3: 100% grounded in client answers with specific Q-### citations. Roles match client personas only. Unconfirmed items filed as ASM-/OQ-.
scale.2: Grounded with valid citations, but 1 citation points to Q-001 instead of specific Q-.
scale.1: Contains invented roles or unsupported boilerplate facts not in discovery.
scale.0: Heavy hallucination of client facts, roles, or requirements.

criteria.name: Timeline, Budget, and Scope Feasibility
criteria.description: v1 fits stated timeline and budget, with explicit reasoning shown in Section 4/9 explaining how deferrals keep the project feasible.

scale.3: Clear timeline and budget constraints cited with explicit feasibility reasoning and scope changes table.
scale.2: Timeline and budget cited, but feasibility reasoning is brief.
scale.1: Timeline/budget mentioned without reasoning on scope fit.
scale.0: Timeline and budget missing or ignored.
